summary: Pre-trial difficulty is genuine: a solver must reason through identity, eligibility/capacity, authoritative restart effects, accounting/reconciliation and close ordering. The 3k+ footprint adds navigation cost, but the main difficulty is coupled state rather than clerical volume. Final tier remains empirical and is not assigned before the combined 10 trials.

evidence.observation: Restart authority and capacity rules create partial-state cases where local fixes can remain globally wrong.
Balanced reconciliation and completion are separate coupled gates with route-specific accounting obligations.
30 F2P cases span 12 requirement groups; the largest F2P concentration is restart/resume rather than a single trivial assertion family.
Strict profile passed with 3080 substantive LOC, 29 interrelated defect manifestations, six root-cause clusters and six cross-cluster pairs.

change_scope: Fresh semantic review under protocol 2.1 / packet-result schema v3; solver-visible task content unchanged.
do_not_change: Do not weaken behavioral verifier coverage or exactly-once/restart invariants merely to improve agent pass rate.

derive total debit and payer capacity from active reservations
classify new vs resumed internal/external effects

gate publication and close without duplicating authorization
